title: Ray–Singer and dynamical Milnor metric comparison for Morse–Smale flows with untwisted closed orbits on closed connected orientable manifolds
author: Shu Shen; Jianqing Yu

difficulty_reason: The cited Franks standardisation and Bismut--Zhang theorem do not by themselves compare the dynamical Milnor metric with the analytic metric for the original Morse--Smale flow. The author constructs the untwisted determinant-line fusion comparison through orbit destruction and proves the matching variation of the characteristic current. Tracking those metric and current contributions, including the negative-vector-field sign, is the nonroutine step that makes the final comparison formula hold.
